title: Access & Identity V2 — promotion / certification reconciliation
why_this_file_exists: The assignment asked for promotion of a 'completed W-0…W-12 implementation tranche', certification against the real shared environment, and continuation into the remaining plan. Reconciliation against the plan of record, the repository, the migration register and the trusted-host registry shows all three of those premises are wrong in ways that change the answer. This file records what was actually verified, by what method, so the next session does not have to re-derive it.

finding_5_no_apply_channel.claim_reconciled: 'Apply migrations only through sanctioned migration paths.'

evidence: scripts/local-dev/lib/vacilando/trusted-host-action-registry.mjs REGISTRY contains exactly one entry: database.read_census.
That action's riskClass is privileged_read, its requiredCapability is trusted_host.database.read, and every input is passed through validateReadOnlySql() before execution.

web/.env.local.agent carries NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY only. SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, database password and direct connection string are absent by two-tier-env design.
MIGRATION-APPLY-GATE.md step 3 says 'Apply on the target DB' without naming an actor; no registered action implements it.
finding_5_no_apply_channel.consequence: M1's operator authorization from 2026-08-07 cannot be executed by anyone in the current system. Creating a database.apply_migration action would be a new privileged-write host capability — a platform-doctrine change and an irreversible shared-data operation, both explicit escalation triggers.
